# Hero Illustration Description

## Overall Layout (left to right)
1. **Text block** (far left, partially cropped): black bold heading ending in "ler." with smaller gray subtext ("...ments" / "...me.")
2. **Mini hospital building** — small, positioned center-left
3. **Doctor character** — large, center-right, dominant element
4. **Two green blob-trees** — one left of the hospital, one right of the doctor

## Background
- Very light cool gray (#F0F2F4 approx.), with a slightly darker rounded panel behind the illustration area
- Top edge (cropped): two white circular icon buttons — one with a black notification bell, one with a black person icon
- Bottom: white search bar with gray placeholder text "hospitals, tests, symptoms..." and a black microphone icon on the right

## Doctor Character
- **Position**: center-right, largest element, roughly 3× the hospital's height
- **Pose**: standing, arms crossed confidently over chest, slight smile, facing viewer with head tilted slightly
- **Hair**: dark brown/black, voluminous swoopy style with a quiff
- **Skin**: warm tan/peach tone
- **Expression**: friendly, small closed smile, thin eyebrows
- **Clothing**: white lab coat (open) over a light blue shirt, blue necktie, dark stethoscope draped around neck with silver chest piece hanging on his left side (viewer's left)
- Stylized 3D "clay/render" cartoon look

## Mini Hospital Building
- **Position**: center-left, behind/beside the doctor, about waist-height to him
- **Colors**: white/light-gray walls, blue-framed rectangular windows (light blue panes with darker blue frames), a dark gray entrance door
- **Cross**: black medical cross on the upper facade, centered
- Simple flat-roof 3D blocky style

## Green Blob-Trees
- **Left tree**: a cluster of rounded green blobs (light green #7CB85C tops, darker green shading) sitting at the hospital's left base
- **Right tree**: similar rounded blob cluster at the doctor's right side (viewer's right), slightly larger, light green with darker green accents
- Both are soft, cloud-like cartoon bushes/trees

## Relative Sizes
Doctor (tallest) → trees (small) → hospital (medium, wider than tall). All sit on an implied ground line, doctor overlapping the hospital's right edge.
